description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemService component, specifically focusing on temperature management, log upload, power state changes, and setting bootloader splash screens. It uses Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to simulate system behaviors and verify expected interactions and events.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock
classes.description: Mock class for internal asynchronous event handling, providing mock methods for temperature threshold changes, log upload changes, and system power state changes.

classes.name: SystemService_L2Test
classes.description: Test fixture class that sets up the environment to test system service functionalities including event handling, temperature management, log uploads, power state transitions, and splash screen settings.
